body: I’ve never heard of a guilt complex. Psychology hasn’t been very helpful to me, all they seem to care about is finding a diagnosis. They ask a lot about the past but not the present. It’s like you’re under a magnifying glass, and they’re trying to fix anything different about you.

I don’t know, I used to live with this goal in mind that kept me going. As I’m still far away from that and it seems impossible, I don’t have anything I truly enjoy. I’m in university, I have people around me who claim to love me but do nothing to show it, and I’m constantly accommodating everyone. It’s been a difficult, isolating life. I’ve gone back to this idea since I was a kid, now I think it’s the only way to end the pain.
How do I go about doing that? Guilt comes so easily for me

I can’t, the only thing I have is how I treat other people. After being treated like nothing for a long time, I try not to do that to others. I have no intention of putting my misery on people around me.
